This is a list of themes that have played in the {{pmin|Ukraine|Ukrainian}} dub of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. All movie endings were left in English. ==Openings== As the first four seasons of the animated series were produced as a {{wp|Voice-over_translation|voice-over}}, their openings were voiced-over as well. The [[Pokémon Theme|first opening]] is featured subtitled on [[Netflix]]. Starting from [[The Journey Starts Today]], the openings started to be actually dubbed. None of the movie openings were ever voiced-over or dubbed, and [[Always Safe]] was only shown with subtitles in ''[[Secrets of the Jungle]]''. ===[[Pokémon Theme|Покемон-тема]]=== ====Original voice-over ==== [[File:OPE01.png|250px|thumb|left|Indigo League]] This opening was read by Анатолій Зіновенко ''Anatoliy Zinovenko''. {{Schemetable|Kanto}} !
